{{Quote|Wow, those ''Republic troopers'' just ''fell to pieces''.''"<br />"''Getting in the path of our ''laser scythe'' has that effect on everyone!|Two [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s|<ref name="Seeds" />}}
The '''laser scythe''' was an energy weapon that equipped the [[scythe harvester]]. It resembled a long [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] mounted on a mechanized arm. The laser scythe was used to clear a path for the harvester and could also cut down enemy troops.

During a [[Battle on an unidentified farming moon|battle]] on a [[Unidentified farming moon|farming moon]] in orbit of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], laser scythes were used to destroy several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] gunships. When [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] commandeered one of the two scythe harvesters, he turned its laser scythe against the other harvester to destroy it.
